name: Janie
source:
Fell Assassin based in the capital. Janie is a young and enthusiastic member of the Fell. Her success as an assassin has caught the eye of [url=https://vndb.org/c165574]Lydia[/url]. Although, Janie's excessive enthusiasm has gotten her into trouble.
